say.zh: 这几年，你在山上修行。没有差事，没筑基，不下山。
say.en: These years you cultivate on the mountain. No errand, and no going down before Foundation.

summary.zh: 大比第二天搬屋，你把赤铜葫芦和盾片扔进饭桶图个干净，它吐出一口剑「火柴」；开春，残株分堆认出方子，饭桶的九转丹叫你进步神速。饭堂里说你偷药园，周衡说「拿赃来」；丹房的闵丹师叫你去看了一颗：「没有火气。」一晃五年，执事堂的差事牌一块一块揭，一年一层；第五年腊八你赢了大比，观里那颗一转的官丹封好收进储物袋；入秋，九层圆满，又揭了那块蒙山的牌子——黑松岭。瞿老讲了他最后一个徒弟——九月初三，你在崖顶筑基。
summary.en: Moving house the day after the contest, you toss the red-copper gourd and the shield shards into the Rice Tub to be rid of them, and it spits out a sword, Matchstick; in spring you sort the culls by herb and find the recipes, and the Rice Tub's nine-turn pills carry you up by leaps. The dining hall says you rob the herb garden; Zhou Heng says "bring the stolen goods"; Pill-master Min of the pill house sends for you and looks at one pill: "No fire in it." Five years go by on the Hall of Errands' tags, a layer a year; at Laba in the fifth year you win the contest, and the temple's one-turn pill, resealed, goes into the storage pouch; in autumn, layer nine, Consummation — and you take down the Mengshan tag: Black Pine Ridge. Old Qu told of his last disciple — and on the third of the ninth month you lay your Foundation on the cliff.

intro.zh: 大比第二天搬屋，他把储物袋倒了个底朝天，一样一样理，理出两样废物。
intro.en: The day after the contest he moved, and turned the storage pouch out onto the boards to sort it, one thing at a time; two pieces of rubbish came out.

mystery.zh: 瞿老四十多年没收过徒弟——他上一个徒弟，后来怎样了？
mystery.en: Old Qu took no disciple for more than forty years — what became of the last one?

did.en: Moving house the day after the contest, tossed the red-copper gourd and the shield shards into the Rice Tub to be rid of them, and it spat out a sword, Matchstick

did.zh: 五年里揭了执事堂的差事牌，腊八赢下了观里那颗一转的官丹，粘好封条收进了储物袋
did.en: took down the Hall of Errands' tags through five years, won the temple's one-turn pill at Laba and glued its seal back into the storage pouch

did.zh: 九月初三，你在崖顶筑了基——师父问几道纹，你说一道
did.en: and on the third of the ninth month you laid your Foundation on the cliff — your master asked how many rings, and you said one

teaser.zh: 却说北边漳水之滨，有一座邺城，城里年年要给河伯娶一回媳妇。今年巫祝挑中的新娘子，是城西卖豆腐的哑女——那时你还不知道，这门亲事，是要你去搅上一搅的。
teaser.en: Up north on the Zhang stands the city of Ye, which marries a bride to the River Lord every year. This year the shaman chose the mute girl who sells tofu on the west side — and you did not yet know that this wedding was yours to spoil.
